headline: 1998 executive order on how federal agencies consult and coordinate with Indian tribal governments.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how federal agencies talk with and work alongside Indian tribal governments. It appears to set expectations for agencies to consult with tribes and coordinate with them. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, steps, and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies appear to be directed to consult and coordinate with tribal governments, though the exact requirements are not stated in the title.
Tribal governments are the intended partners in this consultation and coordination with federal agencies.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 14, 1998; the title does not state an effective date.
